sloka: तथा कोसल राजानम् भानुमंतम् सुसत्कृतम् ।मगध अधिपतिम् शूरम् सर्व शास्त्र विशारदम् ॥१-१३-२६॥
transliteration: tathā kosala rājānam bhānumaṁtam susatkṛtam ।magadha adhipatim śūram sarva śāstra viśāradam ॥1-13-26॥

translations.english: Bring all other kings of this earth, who are friendly with us. Along with their retinues, families and relatives".
